tools.name: gno_context
tools.description: Compile one deterministic, budgeted, extractive evidence Capsule with exact line spans, coverage gaps, omissions, provenance, and verification fingerprints. Raw search/get tools remain available for manual retrieval.

tools.name: gno_context_verify
tools.description: Verify a saved Context Capsule without rebuilding or mutating it. Reports unchanged, stale, missing, reranked, and fingerprint drift states against the active index.

tools.name: gno_ask
tools.description: Generate one answer from a deterministic Context Capsule, verify every substantive claim against exact retained spans, and abstain unless support coverage is complete. Read-only; returns the Capsule, freshness receipt, claim verdicts, gaps, and evidence IDs.

tools.name: gno_recall
tools.description: Recall current facts from a memory-managed collection for explicit scopes. Call before answering about the user's preferences, decisions, people, or prior work, and before gno_remember to find the predecessor of a changed fact. Returns at most 8 facts within 512 tokens by default, each with text, scopes, provenance, gno:// cite, and content hash, plus a content-free receipt; superseded facts are excluded. Pass the receipt to gno_remember when a stored fact derives from this recall. An empty result names the command that stores the first fact.

query.description: What you need to know, phrased as the fact would be stated

scopes.description: Explicit scopes (1-8, e.g. "project:gno"). Visibility is any-intersection; there is no implicit global scope

tools.name: gno_search
tools.description: BM25 keyword search. Fast exact-term lookup for names, identifiers, error text, and known phrases. Structured results include uri/docid, line when available, and optional user-configured context guidance; use gno_get with fromLine/lineCount or gno_multi_get for full context. Use gno_query when wording is uncertain.

query.description: Exact keyword, identifier, filename, error text, or phrase to match with BM25

projectHints.description: Opaque caller project hints for cross-surface parity; remote hints never inspect server paths

collection.description: Filter to a single collection name

minScore.description: Minimum relevance score (0-1). Omit to return all matches

lang.description: BCP-47 language hint for tokenization (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Auto-detected if omitted

intent.description: Disambiguating context for ambiguous queries; not searched directly (e.g. 'programming language' when query is 'python')

exclude.description: Exclude documents containing any of these terms

since.description: Only docs modified after this date (ISO format: 2026-03-01 or 2026-03-01T00:00:00)

until.description: Only docs modified before this date (ISO format)

tagsAll.description: Require ALL of these tags (AND filter)

tagsAny.description: Require ANY of these tags (OR filter)

tools.name: gno_vsearch
tools.description: Vector semantic search. Finds conceptually similar docs with different wording. Structured results preserve optional user-configured context guidance. Best after embeddings are current; use intent to disambiguate short terms. Use gno_query for default hybrid retrieval.

query.description: Natural-language concept to match semantically; use gno_search for exact error text or identifiers

projectHints.description: Opaque caller project hints for cross-surface parity; remote hints never inspect server paths

collection.description: Filter to a single collection name

intent.description: Disambiguating context for ambiguous terms; steers snippet choice without becoming the searched text

exclude.description: Exclude documents containing any of these terms

since.description: Only docs modified after this date (ISO format)

until.description: Only docs modified before this date (ISO format)

tools.name: gno_query
tools.description: Hybrid search (BM25 + vector + default bounded graph expansion + optional query expansion/reranking). Recommended default. Structured results preserve optional user-configured context guidance with source identity. Use intent for ambiguous terms, queryModes to combine term/intent/hyde strategies, fast=true or graph=false for quick lookup, thorough=true when recall matters, and candidateLimit to trade latency for coverage.

query.description: Primary user query; combine with intent or queryModes for ambiguous requests

projectHints.description: Opaque caller project hints for cross-surface parity; remote hints never inspect server paths

collection.description: Filter to a single collection name

lang.description: BCP-47 language hint (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Auto-detected if omitted

intent.description: Disambiguating context (e.g. 'programming language' when query is 'python'); steers expansion, rerank, and snippet choice

candidateLimit.description: Max candidates passed to reranking stage; raise when top results miss relevant docs, lower for latency

exclude.description: Exclude documents containing any of these terms

since.description: Only docs modified after this date (ISO format)

until.description: Only docs modified before this date (ISO format)

mode.description: Retrieval strategy: 'term' for exact lexical anchors, 'intent' for disambiguation, 'hyde' for one hypothetical answer/document to improve semantic matching

text.description: Text for this query mode; keep term modes concise and hyde modes answer-shaped

queryModes.description: Structured query modes for typed retrieval: combine term anchors, intent disambiguation, and at most one hyde hypothetical document

fast.description: Skip query expansion, graph expansion, and reranking (~0.7s). Use for quick lookups

thorough.description: Enable query expansion for best recall (~5-8s). Use for broad research or when default results miss likely docs

graph.description: Enable bounded one-hop graph neighbor expansion (default)

explain.description: Include deterministic stage and per-result scoring metadata

tools.name: gno_query_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose why one target document does or does not appear for a query. Use when an important doc is missing, a filter may exclude it, or you need stage-by-stage BM25/vector/fusion/graph/rerank evidence before changing retrieval strategy.

query.description: Primary user query; combine with intent or queryModes for ambiguous requests

projectHints.description: Opaque caller project hints for cross-surface parity; remote hints never inspect server paths

collection.description: Filter to a single collection name

lang.description: BCP-47 language hint (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Auto-detected if omitted

intent.description: Disambiguating context (e.g. 'programming language' when query is 'python'); steers expansion, rerank, and snippet choice

candidateLimit.description: Max candidates passed to reranking stage; raise when top results miss relevant docs, lower for latency

exclude.description: Exclude documents containing any of these terms

since.description: Only docs modified after this date (ISO format)

until.description: Only docs modified before this date (ISO format)

mode.description: Retrieval strategy: 'term' for exact lexical anchors, 'intent' for disambiguation, 'hyde' for one hypothetical answer/document to improve semantic matching

text.description: Text for this query mode; keep term modes concise and hyde modes answer-shaped

queryModes.description: Structured query modes for typed retrieval: combine term anchors, intent disambiguation, and at most one hyde hypothetical document

fast.description: Skip query expansion, graph expansion, and reranking (~0.7s). Use for quick lookups

thorough.description: Enable query expansion for best recall (~5-8s). Use for broad research or when default results miss likely docs

graph.description: Enable bounded one-hop graph neighbor expansion (default)

explain.description: Include deterministic stage and per-result scoring metadata

target.description: Target document reference to diagnose (gno URI, docid, or collection/path)

tools.name: gno_get
tools.description: Retrieve one document by gno:// URI, docid (#abc123), or collection/path. After search results include line, pass fromLine and lineCount to fetch only the relevant range before expanding to the full document.

ref.description: Document reference: URI (gno://collection/path), docid (#abc123), or collection/path

fromLine.description: Start reading from this line number; use the line returned by search/query results

lineCount.description: Number of lines to return from fromLine; prefer a small range before fetching full docs

traceId.description: Continue an open retrieval trace returned by a search/query

tools.name: gno_section
tools.description: Create or resolve a durable SectionTargetV1 against one indexed document. action=create needs ref plus exactly one of anchor|line; action=resolve needs ref plus target. Exact/recovered include citation (uri, anchor, title, inclusive lines, fingerprint); ambiguous/stale/missing omit citation and are not safe to navigate or cite. Read-only — does not write or persist targets. Follow navigable ranges with gno_get fromLine/lineCount.

ref.description: Document reference: gno:// URI, collection/path, or #docid

tools.name: gno_multi_get
tools.description: Retrieve multiple documents by refs array or glob pattern. Use after gno_search/gno_query to batch top result URIs/docids; set maxBytes and lineNumbers to control context size.

refs.description: Array of document references from search/query results (gno:// URIs or docids)

maxBytes.description: Max bytes per document; lower this when batching many top search results

tools.name: gno_peek
tools.description: Cheap peek@1.0 snapshot: initialized flag, document/collection counts, embedding backlog, recent files, and serve liveness. Model-free — never initializes embeddings or models. Use for counts/backlog/recent/serve questions; use gno_status for full health and activation.

tools.name: gno_status
tools.description: Get index health: collection count, document count, chunk count, embedding backlog, and per-collection stats. Check first when vector/hybrid results look stale or unavailable.

tools.name: gno_audit
tools.description: Run deterministic, offline, read-only integrity audits for links, declared provenance completeness, and source/index freshness. Returns stable bounded findings and explicit partial/unavailable states; never repairs or mutates the workspace.

tools.name: gno_egress_policy_get
tools.description: Show one collection's configured and effective egress policy, provenance source, and confirmation-bound version.

tools.name: gno_egress_check
tools.description: Check or explain an exact action, destination, caller, content class, and collection scope without performing the action.

tools.name: gno_egress_audit_list
tools.description: List content-free local egress decisions newest-first through an opaque cursor.

tools.name: gno_egress_audit_show
tools.description: Inspect one content-free local egress decision receipt.

tools.name: gno_egress_audit_status
tools.description: Show local egress audit retention and storage status.

tools.name: gno_changes
tools.description: List retained metadata-only document changes with opaque cursor pagination and retention disclosure.

tools.name: gno_diff
tools.description: Inspect one retained metadata-only structural document change. Source bodies are never returned.

tools.name: gno_impact
tools.description: Find bounded inbound typed, wiki, and Markdown dependencies with deterministic evidence paths.

tools.name: gno_trace_list
tools.description: List bounded metadata-only summaries of private local retrieval traces. Raw replay queries are omitted from history.

tools.name: gno_trace_show
tools.description: Inspect one bounded local retrieval trace. Replay-mode content is returned only for the explicitly requested trace.

tools.name: gno_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags with document counts. Use prefix to filter hierarchical tags (e.g. 'project/').

collection.description: Filter tags to a single collection

prefix.description: Filter tags by prefix (e.g. 'project/' for hierarchical tags)

tools.name: gno_links
tools.description: Get outgoing wiki ([[links]]) and markdown links from one document. Use after gno_query when you need immediate local expansion from a known source document; use gno_graph_neighbors for bidirectional graph navigation.

tools.name: gno_backlinks
tools.description: Find all documents that link TO a given document. Use after gno_query/gno_get to discover incoming references around a known target; use gno_graph_path for 'how are X and Y connected?' questions.

ref.description: Document reference to find backlinks for

collection.description: Filter backlinks to a single collection

tools.name: gno_similar
tools.description: Find semantically similar documents using vector embeddings. Use for local expansion when wording differs; use gno_query as the default retrieval entry point and gno_graph_neighbors/path for explicit relationship questions.

ref.description: Document reference to find similar docs for

crossCollection.description: Search across all collections (not just the document's own collection)

tools.name: gno_graph
tools.description: Get graph report/stats plus nodes/edges for corpus navigation. Use for unfamiliar corpus structure, hubs/isolates/unresolved links, or custom graph analysis; do not replace normal retrieval with this. Start with gno_query for content questions, then graph tools for relationship context, then gno_get for targeted reads.

collection.description: Filter graph to a single collection

includeSimilar.description: Include vector-similarity edges (not just wiki/markdown links)

similarTopK.description: Max similar docs per node when includeSimilar=true

tools.name: gno_graph_query
tools.description: Run bounded traversal over typed doc_edges from one root document. Use for explicit relationship questions like 'what does Alice work_at within 2 hops?' or to inspect typed graph hints; returns schemaVersion, root, nodes, edges, caps, and truncation.

ref.description: Root document reference for typed-edge traversal: gno URI, docid, or collection/path

edgeType.description: Semantic edge type filter, e.g. mentions or works_at

relation.description: Alias for edgeType; must match edgeType when both are set

tools.name: gno_graph_neighbors
tools.description: Find graph neighbors around a document/node. Use for relationship questions, missed obvious related docs, or unfamiliar corpus navigation after gno_query identifies a seed; returns incoming/outgoing wiki, markdown, and optional similarity edges. Follow with gno_get for targeted reads.

collection.description: Filter graph to a single collection

includeSimilar.description: Include vector-similarity edges (not just wiki/markdown links)

similarTopK.description: Max similar docs per node when includeSimilar=true

ref.description: Document/node reference: gno URI, #docid, collection/path, relPath, or exact title

direction.description: Which graph edges to follow from the reference node

tools.name: gno_graph_path
tools.description: Find the shortest relationship path between two documents/nodes. Use for prompts like 'how are X and Y connected?' or to explain corpus relationships. Use gno_query for finding candidate refs first, then gno_get on path nodes for evidence.

collection.description: Filter graph to a single collection

includeSimilar.description: Include vector-similarity edges (not just wiki/markdown links)

similarTopK.description: Max similar docs per node when includeSimilar=true

tools.name: gno_job_status
tools.description: Check status of an async job (embed, index). Returns progress percentage and completion state.

jobId.description: Job ID returned by async operations (embed, index)

tools.name: gno_list_jobs
tools.description: List active and recently completed async jobs with their status and progress.
